places.name: Nevado de Chañi
places.department: Jujuy Province (P131 points directly to province); on the border of Tumbaya and Valle Grande departments, also close to the Salta provincial border
places.description: montaña en Argentina
places.notes: Researched as a candidate for 'highest summit of Jujuy' per task instructions rather than assuming it. Elevation is inconsistent across sources: Wikidata P2044 gives 5949 m; the Spanish Wikipedia article on Jujuy Province states in its geography section that Chañi reaches 6200 m, while that same article's infobox lists 5896 m as the province's maximum altitude (attributed to Chañi). All three sources agree Nevado de Chañi is the commonly cited highest point of Jujuy; the exact figure is genuinely disputed across sources, so no single elevation should be treated as definitive for the map.
places.coordinatorReview: Elevación según fuentes: 5949 (Wikidata), 6200 y 5896 (es.wikipedia). El DEM del proyecto da 5871 m en la coordenada; para fichas usar el DEM (AGENTS.md).
